script.speaker: brooke
script.text: summer's almost over and this crew has never once eaten by the water. tonight we fix that!

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: also i beat liam paddleboarding this morning, so winner picks. GREEK. the whole boardwalk smells like lemon and charcoal

script.speaker: liam
script.text: i fell in twice and swallowed half the harbour. greek sounds perfect. i'm starving

script.speaker: mina
script.text: greek by the water sounds lovely :) liam, are you okay after all that swimming?

script.speaker: liam
script.text: my pride's a little soggy. the rest of me is just hungry

script.speaker: mina
script.text: okay, can i ask for something? could we go somewhere i can order a real main this time?

script.speaker: mina
script.text: i've had enough side salads and plates of fries to last me a lifetime

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: MINA. yes. you asking for something might be my favourite thing that's happened all summer

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: yes!! ooh, the harbour places do amazing grilled fish. would that work for you?

script.speaker: mina
script.text: not fish either, sorry :) just a proper main of my own, not something i build out of the starters

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: our first dinner on the water deserves a crowd. a packed room, people laughing over each other, plates flying past. a hushed little dining room would feel like summer ended early

script.speaker: liam
script.text: i'll be the one at the table still wringing harbour out of my socks

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: also, after a whole summer of night-market fryers, i want a light plate. the kind you finish feeling better than when you sat down

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: oh wait, i'm taking the water taxi back. bobbing boat, ten whole minutes

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: ...so maybe no yogurt dips or crumbly cheese in mine. just remembered why

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: roxy, a bobbing boat and the milkshake incident in one evening? i'm sitting at the far end of that taxi

script.speaker: liam
script.text: i've been dripping on this boardwalk for an hour. feed me please, assistant
